en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square framed by an arch. Prominent is an ornate historic town hall with a tall clock tower and baroque details, facing a row of 2‑storey buildings and a busy street with pedestrians. At the bottom front side, Hungarian captions identify the scene as Pécs and Széchenyi Square with the town hall. The reverse side has handwritten correspondence, an address to Czechoslovakia, a Hungarian postage stamp and a small printer's mark from Budapest.
